options: An object that runs a notebook (or pipeline) on a schedule, with no person present

questions.q: What is a task, in the context of a job?
options: One step in a job — jobs can chain several tasks in sequence, each depending on the one before it
A synonym for a widget

The schedule expression itself, like a cron string

questions.q: How does a job supply a value into a notebook that expects a widget input?

The job automatically disables all widgets before running
Job parameters only work with dropdown widgets, never text widgets

questions.q: Where do you check whether a scheduled job's last run actually succeeded?

In the Unity Catalog audit log exclusively
